manifest.name: Tiny summarizer (SmolLM2 360M Q8_0)
manifest.description: Writes a one-sentence English summary of a short message.

operations.title: Summarize
operations.when: shorten the text into a brief summary
examples: Hi Sam, because of a storm your flight to Lisbon on Friday will leave two hours late, at 16:40. Your seat and bags stay the same.
Your electricity bill of $84.20 is due on March 3. Pay online before then to avoid a late fee.

prompt.system: You summarize messages in one short sentence. Keep the key facts. Do not add anything.
prompt.template:
Summarize this message in one short sentence:

{{text}}

memory_mb.notes: file size + KV cache + compute buffers, CPU/WASM

_comment: Primary location is a deliberately corrupted mirror copy (one flipped byte): clients must reject it and fall back (A10).
